rationale: The request "Clean up this codebase" is inherently ambiguous – cleanup can mean many things, from removing unused code to refactoring to formatting. The agent identified duplicate functionality ( `process_order` and `process_order2`, `CalcTotal` and `calc_total`), but it did not acknowledge the ambiguity of the cleanup task itself, nor did it state any assumptions about *what* constituted cleanup. It simply listed the files and their contents. While a reasonable interpretation was chosen (examining the code), the lack of acknowledgment of the open-ended nature of the request results in a score of 3.
